projection_replay.method: Each record was scope-checked before measurement decoding. Every scalar/null was compared exactly to the independently selected original source row/frame/field. No numerical tolerance, interpolation, imputation or source-derived replacement was used for equality. Unique complete row/frame sets and exact one-based-to-zero-based pointer conversion were checked, then the actual Projection schema was validated.
projection_replay.binding_record_replay: Both source-binding artifact bytes/digests were checked. Their source/approval/phase identities, ordered payload digests, comparison counts and null counts equal the independently recomputed results, rather than being accepted as True flags.
projection_replay.payload_digest_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({group_ids,source_cells,source_times}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) followed by one newline, matching the recorded producer convention in scripts/export_granados_training.py:1409-1413,1503-1507.

transformation_replay.status: PASS for the approved information set
transformation_replay.individual_observable: max5/median for the same original row and frame. It is a dimensionless image-derived proxy, not phosphorylation, an absolute nuclear fraction, protein abundance, enzyme activity or flux.
transformation_replay.prefix_cohort: Require all 20 prefix entries to have finite nonnegative max5, finite strictly positive median and finite strictly negative measured relative time. The minimum is two rows. No response-frame intensity or future completeness condition enters cohort selection.
transformation_replay.prefix_summaries: mu is the mean of 20 across-cell frame means of individual ratios; s is the mean of 20 across-cell sample SDs with denominator n-1, not pooled cell-time SD. The target is not divided by s.
transformation_replay.time_coordinate: At each response frame, average finite positive general/times over the fixed prefix cohort, without consulting response max5/median validity. Actual timestamps are retained; no nominal time grid or subtraction of origin-as-minutes is used.
transformation_replay.training_targets: Mean valid individual ratios at each registered frame over the observed subset of the fixed prefix cohort. Per-frame valid/missing/invalid counts and sample SD retain attrition; absence at one frame does not delete the entire row. This is not a ratio of mean intensities or an imputed full-culture mean.
transformation_replay.comparison: Prefix cohort indices, mu/s digests, measured response-coordinate digests and all three training aggregate/attrition trace digests recomputed from actual exported records match the earlier independent primary-source replay exactly.
transformation_replay.development_responses: Not read or computed. Only prefix/timing transformations were evaluated for rep4/rep5; the manifest's private coverage assertions are not promoted to independent response evidence.
transformation_replay.trace_digest_convention: UTF-8 canonical Python JSON with sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False and no trailing newline. Prefix summaries hash {mu,s}; timings hash the frame-to-time map. Arithmetic uses statistics.fmean and sample statistics.stdev.

The unexported remainder of a released biological experiment is not a fresh independent holdout. Unknown aliases stay unknown and inherit development exposure if later identified.

Original published selection, filtering and inpainting may have used later observations. The estimand is the processed published cohort's observed-subcohort mean, not an unselected culture or certified prospective forecast.
Glucose concentrations remain percent_as_reported; no unsupported w/v or molar conversion. Timing is measured switch-relative minutes. No [0,1] phosphorylation interpretation is imposed on the ratio.
All groups share one reported downshift. No causal glucose dependence, dose-response, biochemical mechanism, active-enzyme quantity, metabolic flux or universal law is identified.

Within-frame dispersion and cell counts are descriptive, not calibrated biological confidence intervals or extra biological replicates. Attrition and unmeasured covariance/processing biases remain explicit.

Every future source/window/model failure must remain in the record; no post-error replacement of groups, cohorts or frames. Complete future development comparison still requires the sealed six-family prediction lattice and then separately authorized response access.
No strong biological ready label, final test, external cryptographic attestation or authorization of protocol-01 is issued by this review.
